parameter_use: Defaults must match frozen manifest; odd test-only relocation exercises crossing branch without duplicating production ROM
mapping: byte_offset=base+2*index; word=floor(byte_offset/20); lane=byte_offset%20; lane19 requires word+1 low byte
address_algorithm: 18-step unsigned restoring division by20, then registered location; no inferred multiplier or divider
rom_reader: Read-only ROM-R1 road_numeric_rom_reader existing valid/ready, addr13, data160, sticky fault; no tag or cancel port
reset: Common async assert with reader, 2FF sync release locally; reset valid/ownership only, no ROM/table copy
cancel: Block LUT outputs/new requests immediately; accepted untagged ROM read must drain and discard before slot reuse. Reader is NOT reset by cancel. Cancel before second read suppresses it. ROM fault requires common reset.
faults: Wrong model or exp index>=256 returns held error response with original identity and zero data, no ROM read. ROM fault returns error for owned request and sticky o_fault; cancellation discards owned response.
verification: cancel while ROM pending and late response then restart
boundary: Controlled ROM endpoint tests only; C7 owns actual ROM-R1 arbitration/connection. No full-ROM duplication, no NMS/CNN/DDR/production changes.
